criteria.detail: Every persisted payload and referenced file is checksummed.
AST check of direct agent-class calls.
Actual train/validation evidence audited before any training.
Exact supporting quotes resolve to checksummed snapshots; recommendations remain hypotheses.
Curated excerpts alone do not demonstrate web retrieval.
Test metrics are excluded from search and configuration selection.
Conventional baseline uses the same seed and selected splits; negative deltas are retained.
At least three completed seeds, with a shared validation-selected configuration.
Validation-calibrated abstention with a persistent benchmark review queue.
Every promoted stage has an independent reviewer report.
Decision source and stage are recorded; exact prompts/schema/results are retained.
Requires passing tests and measured fault injection for this exact source tree.
A transcript alone is not proof that retraining reproduces predictions and metrics.
Every unresolved reviewer issue requires an explicit approved mitigation.
Requires named independent demonstrator/reviewer, bound predictions and checksummed environment evidence.

unresolved_reviewer_issues: 28×28 resolution ambiguity risks (background/debris/mucus, adipose vs. background, smooth muscle vs. stroma, lymphocytes vs. debris) require per-class metrics in downstream evaluation
Analysis text is truncated mid-sentence; ensure full text is persisted for auditability
Prior-art citation arxiv_2508_18509v1 (machine-unlearning paper) is tangential to the tissue-polarity augmentation-quality claim; verify or replace with a directly relevant source

Recommended augmentations 'rotation ±10 degrees' and 'translation ±2 pixels' are not in the built-in primitive set and have no corresponding extension proposal; they will be unavailable at training time unless filed and approved

compact_transformer is top-priority in research but its extension (compact_conv_token_transformer, spec_sha256=4004d69e…) is still pending_review; no implementation may proceed until hash-bound review completes

ghostnet_vgg_robustness prior-art idea has a weak logical bridge from quantization-robustness to class-imbalance generalization; correctly tagged hypothesis_to_validate but must not be treated as supported
hflip_only_aug extension is pending_review but hflip is already a built-in primitive; the pending status is redundant and should be noted to avoid confusion
llm_model_digest is null for qwen3.8 (Oollama) across all artefacts; LLM-component traceability is incomplete
